title: A Paired, Floor-Guarded Evaluation Protocol for INT8 and FP8 Object Detectors under Image Corruptions: Reproducibility Package
description:
Reproducibility package accompanying the manuscript A Paired, Floor-Guarded Evaluation Protocol for INT8 and FP8 Object Detectors under Image Corruptions, prepared for Computer Vision and Image Understanding.

The release contains analysis and validation code, frozen configurations and manifests, compact deterministic evidence ledgers, generated tables and figures, and manuscript and supplementary sources. It supports reproduction of reported summaries from retained evidence. Raw benchmark datasets, trained checkpoints, TensorRT engines, raw predictions, and machine-specific caches are not redistributed; their provenance and regeneration boundaries are documented in the package.

Project concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.22031663.
